Indian Navy to commission indigenous stealth frigate INS Mahendragiri on July 11

The Indian Navy will commission the indigenous stealth frigate INS Mahendragiri into its fleet on July 11. The warship is the sixth stealth frigate to join the Navy and is equipped with an advanced suite of weapons and sensors. Its induction is intended to strengthen India's maritime security.
